correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of all \(4^9\) target assignments yields \(720\) cells with vector \((90,270,270,90)\). The explicit stagewise face-poset matching has \(359\) pairs; exhaustive orientation of all \(1917\) Hasse covers is acyclic and leaves exactly one critical cell in dimensions \(0\) and \(1\). Forman discrete Morse theory then gives \(S^1\). Independent mod-2 cellular boundary ranks \((89,180,90)\) give Betti numbers \((1,1,0,0)\).
